notes: The source URL and catalog text belong to the English Associate in Arts for Transfer (A.A.-T), Fall 2026 program map, not to the General Science A.S. Degree. The text contains no General Science section, so no blocks, totals, outcomes or careers were recorded.

Many closed-list science and math courses appear in the text only as Cal-GETC general education options (Areas 2, 5A, 5B, 5C) within the English A.A.-T map. GE courses are never placed in blocks, and they are not General Science major requirements.
The excerpt is cut off at both ends: it starts mid-word ('thods in Psychology') and ends mid-entry ('ENGL24B - Native American Prose and P').
A reviewer should retrieve the correct Cabrillo College 2026-2027 General Science A.S. catalog page and re-extract the requirements.
